items.headline: Iran ne parmanu sthalon ke paas iodine baanta
items.detail: America ke hamle ke dar ke beech Iran ne apne parmanu sthalon ke paas rehne wale logon ko iodine ki goliyan baantni shuru kar di hain; The Times of London ki report ke anusar Pickaxe Mountain sthal par hamle ki aashanka hai.
items.exam_angle: Iran parmanu karyakram aur America se tanav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: White House ke paas hathiyarbhand vyakti giraftar
items.detail: America ki Secret Service ne White House ke paas ek chori ki gaadi me teen hathiyaron ke saath Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos ko giraftar kiya; usne kaha awaazein use Trump ko maarne ko keh rahi thi, DHS ke anusar ve hirasat me hai.
items.exam_angle: America me rashtrapati ki suraksha aur Secret Service ki bhoomika — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Qatar: America-Iran samjhauta vaarta jaari, khabar jhoothi
items.detail: Qatar ke media office ne kaha ki PM ke bayan ko online bigada gaya; dono paksh samjhote ki taraf kaam kar rahe hain aur madhyasthata jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Paschim Asia me Qatar ki madhyasthata — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Ukraine ne Saratov refinery par drone hamla kiya
items.detail: Raat bhar ke hamle me Saratov refinery me aag lag gayi aur Oryol ki Proton factory par Neptune missile gira; Russia ne 411 drone rokne ka daava kiya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh me oorja dhanche par hamle — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Zelenskyy: Yuddh khatm kiye bina samjhauta khatarnak
items.detail: CNN ko diye interview me Zelenskyy ne kaha, yuddh khatm kiye bina Russia-Europe ke beech naya suraksha samjhauta khatarnak hoga, khaas taur par EU ke liye; Ukraine, America aur Russia ke beech ek hafte me trilateral baatchit hogi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur Europe ki suraksha vyavastha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: FDA: Zolgensma gene therapy se tumour ka khatra
items.detail: America ki FDA ne Novartis ki Zolgensma gene therapy se tumour ke khatre ki jaanch shuru ki; do bachchon me vector ke DNA judne ke saboot mile, kul nau mamle darj hue.
items.exam_angle: Gene therapy ki suraksha aur FDA ki nigrani — swasthya aur vigyan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Guterres: COP31 jalvayu par satya ka pal
items.detail: UN mahasachiv Antonio Guterres ne COP31 se pehle kaha ki jalvayu parivartan par ab 'satya ka pal' hai; 9-20 November ko Antalya me shikhar sammelan hoga, unke karyakal ka aakhri bada sandesh.
items.exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu sammelan aur Paris samjhauta ka 1.5°C lakshya — paryavaran aur antarrashtriya sangathan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Pope Leo ka 12-din ka Latin America daura
items.detail: Pope Leo XIV ne fefde ke cancer ki surgery ke teen hafte baad Dakshin America ka 12-din ka daura shuru kiya; ve Uruguay, Argentina aur Peru jayenge, 17 November ko Peru me samapt hoga.
items.exam_angle: Pope Leo XIV ka pehla bada Latin America daura — Vatican aur vishva dharm ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America: Iran par khabar par $2 crore inaam
items.detail: America ne Iran ke parmanu karyakram par jaankari ke liye 20 million dollar tak ka inaam aur sambhav sthanantaran ki ghoshna ki; CENTCOM ne Rewards for Justice karyakram ke tahat jaankari mangi.
items.exam_angle: Iran parmanu karyakram aur America ki niti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ke Qeshm dweep par do missile gire
items.detail: Iran ki Tasnim agency ke anusar Qeshm dweep ke Suza kshetra me do missile gire. Update — Trump ne pushti ki America ne Iran ki vayu raksha pranali par seemit hamle kiye; Iran ne America ka MQ-9 drone giraye jaane ka daava kiya hai, jiski America ne pushti nahi ki hai. CENTCOM ke anusar sthiti shaant hai.
items.exam_angle: Faras ki khadi ke paas sthit Qeshm dweep — America-Iran tanav ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Paraguay: Rashtrapati Pena hataye gaye, nazarband
items.detail: Paraguay ki Senate ne Ueno Bank ghotala ke baad Rashtrapati Santiago Pena ko mahaabhiyog se hataya; ve ghar me nazarband hain, aur Up-Rashtrapati Pedro Alliana ne shapath li.
items.exam_angle: Paraguay me rashtrapati par mahaabhiyog — Latin America ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Office of the President, Taiwan / CC BY 4.0

items.headline: America ki Madhya Purv me suraksha chetavni
items.detail: America ne Madhya Purv ke 10 deshon me reh rahe nagrikon ko Houthi hamlo aur udan radd hone ke khatre par satark rehne ki chetavni di; Videsh Vibhag ne hawai kshetra band hone aur yatra me badha ki aashanka jatai.
items.exam_angle: Madhya Purv me America-Iran tanav aur suraksha chetavni — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America me khasa 35 saal me sabse zyada
items.detail: CDC ke anusar 2026 me America me khasa ke 5,182 mamle mile — 1991 ke baad sabse zyada; kam se kam 8 logon ki maut hui.
items.exam_angle: America me khasa ka punarutthan aur teekakaran — swasthya aur UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kyiv par raat bhar ballistic missile hamle
items.detail: Russia ne 6-7 November ki raat Kyiv par ballistic missileon ki kai lehrein chalai; Solomianskyi jile me ek aawasiya imarat kshatigrast hui aur aag lagi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — Kyiv ki urja aur nagrik buniyadi dhanche par hamle.

items.headline: Amsterdam me Microsoft data centre par pradarshan
items.detail: Amsterdam me saikadon pradarshankari Microsoft ke data centre ke nirman sthal me ghus gaye, crane par chadhe aur flare jalaye; police ne 150-200 logon ko giraftar kiya.
items.exam_angle: Europe me data centre virodh aur AI ki urja maang — paryavaran aur takneek ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Miller bane Trump ke chief of staff
items.detail: Trump ne Stephen Miller ko White House chief of staff banaya; Susie Wiles ne midterm haar ke baad istifa diya, Miller 9 November se pad sambhalenge.
items.exam_angle: America ke White House me bada badlav — midterm chunaav ke baad ki rajneeti.

items.headline: Rubio ki pehli videsh yatra: Paris me G7 baithak
items.detail: America ke Videsh Mantri Marco Rubio 8-10 November ko Paris me G7 videsh mantriyon se milenge; midterm haar ke baad ye unki pehli videsh yatra hai.
items.exam_angle: G7 videsh mantri baithak — Ukraine aur Iran par charcha.

items.headline: Khadi me tanker par hamla, navik ki maut
items.detail: Marshall Islands ke tanker MT Velos Sapphire par Khadi me sandehspad missile hamle ke baad visfot hua; operator Velos Tankers ne ek navik ki maut ki pushti ki, jahaz Bahrain le jaya gaya.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg aur samudri suraksha — antarrashtriya vyapar ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Yemen: Taiz bazaar hamle me 30 ki maut
items.detail: Yemen ke Taiz me Al-Hadara bazaar par hamle me kam se kam 30 log mare gaye aur 8 ghayal hue; Houthi aur sarkari bal ek dusre par aarop laga rahe hain, zimmedari abhi tay nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Yemen me griha yuddh aur manaviya sankat — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Congo me hamle me 33 ki maut
items.detail: Purvi Congo ke Cantine gaon me ADF ladakon ke hamle me kam se kam 33 log mare gaye; Ebola ke marijo ko swasthya kendra se bhaagna pada.
items.exam_angle: Congo me Ebola aur sashastr hinsa — Africa ki swasthya aur suraksha chunauti.

items.headline: America me October me 1.65 lakh naukriyan
items.detail: America me October me 1,65,000 naukriyan judi aur berozgari 4.1% rahi; BLS ke anusar bharti September se zyada rahi.
items.exam_angle: America ki rozgar report — vaishvik arthvyavastha aur Fed ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Zaporizhia sahayata kendra hamle me 53 ki maut
items.detail: Zaporizhia ke Komyshuvakha gaon me sahayata kendra par Russian hamle me marne walon ki sankhya 53 ho gayi; malbe me dabe logon ki khoj jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh me nagrikon par sabse ghatak hamlo me se ek.

items.headline: Tanzania: Lissu deshdroh se bari, 4 saal jail
items.detail: Tanzania ki High Court ne vipakshi neta Tundu Lissu ko deshdroh ke aarop se bari kar diya, lekin chunav bhadkane ke aarop me chaar saal ki saza sunai; ve appeal karenge.
items.exam_angle: Tanzania me vipakshi neta par faisla — Africa ki rajneeti aur loktantra ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Najib ka house arrest ruka, jail me rahenge
items.detail: Malaysia ke Attorney-General ne poorv PM Najib Razak ke house arrest par asthayi rok lagayi, RM50 million jurmana bharne ke baad bhi; shahi maafi ki vyakhya par sawal uthaye gaye.
items.exam_angle: 1MDB ghotala aur Malaysia ki rajneeti — bhrashtachar aur kanoon ke liye mahatvapurna.
